title: resource-lock
description: A claim on a shared machine-level resource (the authenticated browser, a port, a proxy). NOT a separate file: resource claims are embedded in the `resources` array of a worktree lock (worktree-lock.schema.json references this one by $ref). The enclosing worktree lock's cwd/session identify the holder; mutual exclusion is a scan across all worktree locks (see slots.mjs claimResource). Versioned via `v`; a claim written by an older sm is upgraded by elevateResourceLock before use.

task.description: one-line reason the resource was claimed
